title: Milkup fixed official Mermaid product integration acceptance preparation
executionModel: Declarative future test-case catalog; driver adapters and product PNG integration are not implemented by this file.

scope.productBoundaryApproval: Required before implementing or distributing the changed product trust boundary; existing prototype/evidence authorization is not expanded here.

implementationRules: Reuse existing service context guards and manager activation epochs.
Private host adapter only; no arbitrary-plugin access to the fixed rendering service.
Keep CI scaffold and product same-login coordinator distinct.
Keep every result null until an actual harness run supplies exact source/platform/evidence.
Unavailable resources or token contexts are blocked/unverified, never skipped-as-passed.

deferred_renderer.construction: Use a test-owned deferred promise; independently control queue admission, process ready, renderer completion and image decode. No real plugin or browser execution in unit tests.

variants: reviewed package fingerprint plus active catalog generation plus renderer ID plus host activation epoch
same plugin/renderer names but unreviewed package fingerprint
private_identities.rule: Identity originates from the host catalog; plugin-supplied claims never grant service access.

png_buffers.construction: Generate a nonuniform PNG using the existing image test dependency; base dimensions 1280x74, complete chunks and matching declared metadata. Derive mutations without adding libraries.
png_buffers.rule: Test each configured bound immediately below, at, and above the limit; the catalog does not invent a new product limit.

lease_counter.construction: Instrument native output lease acquisition/release and Blob URL create/revoke independently; allow decode to settle after disposal.

variants: Chinese and emoji around a Mermaid fence
same document ID and version with a different source object
document_pair.rule: Keep original bytes and independently record document identity, source identity, version, fence range/body hash and selection.

variants: same ID manually imported package without reviewed bundled receipt
plugin_history.rule: Never modify an actual user catalog; all histories live in exclusive temporary stores.

fixed_grammar.manifestScope: 37 fixed Mermaid12.2.0 built-in registration IDs plus13 selected variants; not every grammar production.
fixed_grammar.additionalCoverage: Before a full-version claim, enumerate supported syntax/options from the pinned official distribution; resolve optional external modules/icon assets explicitly rather than silently excluding them.

native_owned_process.construction: Only self-authored inert helpers and fresh owned temporary roots; coordinator and child ownership are recorded. No installed product or third-party process attachment.
